announcements.t: New RSS Feed: Plugins Recently Published
announcements.s: View recently published plugins in the bottom-left of your dashboard and subscribe to the new Plugins RSS feed .
Turn on "Use my own AI key" in the AI Dashboard plugin settings to generate renders with your own Anthropic or OpenRouter key instead of AI credits.

If a plugin keeps failing and stops updating, we now email you with a plain text next step, like reconnecting an account or fixing a calendar link. Then we retry the connection once a day until it starts working again.
Specify text sizing on a per-section basis so one plugin can read large while neighbors stay dense. Learn more .
Pick which Stats boxes and Chart metric the Google Analytics plugin renders. Up to 4 stats plus a chart, including your property's events.
The new Sticky device, a 4" magnetic ePaper display, may be turned into a TRMNL for just $35 (usually $50). Learn more .
Google Calendar, Withings, and Netatmo plugins now have a "Remove" button beside each linked account, so you can drop 1 without disturbing connections to the others.
Your device's battery page now predicts the day it'll need a charge, right beside the charge percent. Check it out .
